create.name: Pascal Auclair
create.bio:
Pascal Auclair is a teacher of insight meditation who has practised Buddhism since 1997, sitting long retreats in Asia and North America with both monastic and lay teachers. Joseph Goldstein and Jack Kornfield were his mentors at IMS in Barre, Massachusetts, and at California's Spirit Rock, and he now leads residential retreats at both, as well as in Europe. He is one of the founders of True North Insight, the Montréal-based Canadian insight community, and remains one of its guiding teachers alongside Daryl Lynn Ross and Roxanne Dault.

He teaches in both French and English. In Montréal he leads a weekly French-language evening sitting at True North Insight, in person and streamed, while many of his retreat talks and hour-long online classes are in English. His teaching is rooted in the classical Theravada framework of mindfulness of body and mind, not-self and letting go, delivered with warmth, wit and an emphasis on closeness and tenderness in ordinary life. He has also spoken about dharma practice and racism and about queer experience on the path. His livelihood depends largely on donations, and many of his talks are freely available online.

courses.title: The Clinging Mind: How We Let Go to Get Free
courses.description: A four-part recorded course on Sangha Live that looks at how the sense of self is built, how grasping at pleasure, views and identity keeps us stuck, and how to loosen that grip. Open to newcomers and seasoned meditators alike.

courses.title: Tuesday Sittings in French at True North Insight
courses.description: A weekly French-language evening of meditation instruction, a guided sit and a Dhamma talk, held in person at True North Insight in Montréal and streamed on Zoom. He leads it on a rota with other TNI teachers, offered on a donation basis.

free_resources.title: Pascal Auclair's Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: His archive of recorded retreat talks and guided practices from True North Insight, IMS and other centres, mostly in English. Free to stream or download.
